title: Sum an array with a pointer
hints: You need a running total that starts at 0, and one step per element.
Loop `i` from 0 to `n - 1` and add `p[i]` to the total. `p[i]` is the same as `*(p + i)`.
When `n` is 0 the loop body never runs, so `p` (maybe `NULL`) is never read. Return the total after the loop.
explain: A `for` loop adds `p[i]` for each `i < n`. Because the loop condition is checked before the first read, `n = 0` returns 0 without touching `p`, which is what makes `sum(NULL, 0)` safe.
